messages:
maria (eng-security): Heads up — QSA call just finished with Zenith (vendor). They requested a few follow-ups around RBAC scoping, audit log exports, and KMS key rotation policy. I took notes, posting action items.
vendor-qsa: thanks maria. Quick clarification: for audit logs you said retention is 'configurable' — does that mean customers can set retention per org, or is it fixed on our side? we need that in the report.
jamal (product): we expose log retention via the Console per-tenant settings, default 90 days, can be bumped to 365 with Enterprise plan. will that satisfy?
vendor-qsa: default + upgrade option is fine, want exact retention fields for the questionnaire (names & API endpoints).
olga (customer-success): i'll attach the Admin UI screenshots + API docs. @maria can you confirm the API path and required scopes?
maria (eng-security): API path for export: POST /v1/admin/orgs/:org_id/logs/export. Required OAuth scope: logs:read:org and admin:export. Export payload supports time_range and dest S3/GCS.
maria (eng-security): sample audit line (we sent to the QSA):
```
2026-07-12T15:22:03Z org=org_348 user=maria action=role.update target=user_922 role=viewer result=success ip=18.204.12.5 request_id=req-0a1b2c
```
vendor-qsa: perfect. also: KMS key policy — do you rotate keys automatically? what's rotation cadence?
sre-bot: scheduled task: kms-key-rotation-check ran 2026-07-12T00:00:00Z, all keys compliant. (run_id: rotate-2026-07-12)
maria (eng-security): we support two modes: customer-managed keys (bring-your-own-key) with manual rotation per customer, and Redwood-managed keys rotated every 90 days. We document this in the KMS section of the security questionnaire.
jamal (product): note: for BYOK we require the customer to provide ARN + grant; our role only has Encrypt/Decrypt and cannot export raw key material. include that language.
olga (customer-success): vendor asked about RBAC change approvals — they want evidence of least-privilege reviews and a recent change ticket. can we pull a ticket and evidence?
maria (eng-security): yes — we have a JIRA workflow for role changes. Example ticket: SEC-2791, includes approver audit and change diff. i'll export sanitized screenshot and the approver list.
vendor-qsa: last question: incident response — if a user reports a possible privilege escalation, what's the typical triage timeline?
maria (eng-security): SLA: initial triage within 4 hours for high priority, full investigation within 72 hours. we escalate to SRE & CS for customer-impacting incidents.
jamal (product): can we add a small paragraph describing automated detection? e.g., alert rules that flag anomalous role grants, high-risk IPs, and immediate temporary suspension of tokens.
maria (eng-security): yes. alert rules live in ops/alerting; i'll paste the rule names in the evidence bundle.
maria (eng-security): ACTIONS: 1) olga — upload Console screenshots + API doc (due 2026-07-14). 2) maria — export SEC-2791 + redacted approver audit (due 2026-07-13). 3) jamal — draft BYOK sentence and non-exportability note (due 2026-07-14). 4) sre-bot — confirm rotation logs attached (automatic). tagging @vendor-qsa for any follow-ups. :thumbsup:
vendor-qsa: thanks all — if you can send the bundle link we'll mark the QSA report as in progress. prefer a single archive with docs + screenshots.
maria (eng-security): uploading now to the shared drive, link: https://files.redwood.ai/secure/zenith-qsa-evidence-2026-07-12.zip
olga (customer-success): got it, forwarding to Zenith. closing this thread unless more questions. :white_check_mark:
